crossRefs.note: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”
if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over…
who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces…

translations.web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
translations.bsb: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
translations.kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
translations.asv: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
